task_title: Give the AI runner Floor-2 collapse-deadline awareness

plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (gpt-5.4) verdict approved_with_changes. (1) BLOCKING: single-seed validation violates rule #12 - resolved by categorizing the whole published release baseline (149 timeouts, 115 with all 4 dens dead) and running a 10-seed local smoke rather than gating on one seed; the next release sweep is the canonical rate re-measurement. (2) stale plan wording about a module that already existed - non-blocking, plan text corrected. (3) reuse the exact stair-availability guard from autoFloor2ProgressionSystem and cover timer-without-spawned-stairs / missing staircasePos - implemented in resolveManifestFloorCollapseState and covered in tests/unit/ai-floor-collapse-deadline.test.ts. (4) blast radius wider than stated: Floor-2 panic now also feeds Collect, opportunistic collect/farm, dynamic weights, run-plan urgency, quest-giver detour and travel spacing - accepted deliberately (that is the same coupling Floor 1 already has) and watched via the smoke seed mix for new deaths/stalls. (5) ship the smaller travel-aware fix first before any explicit exit-priority override - followed; no priority-order change was made.

independent_grade.notes: The change perfectly addresses the Floor 2 collapse deadline awareness issue by correctly resolving the manifest timer and plumbing it into the existing panic profile calculations. The scope is highly disciplined, introducing only the required resolution logic without unrelated refactoring. Test coverage is excellent, featuring both robust unit tests for the edge cases of staircase spawning and a full integration test demonstrating the decision flip from loot sweeping to stair descent. The solution adheres to determinism and pure-function standards, and the copious inline documentation makes it highly maintainable.
